Default Firedancer validator configuration for paths, networking, snapshots, tiles, and development options.

# Purpose
This file defines the main runtime configuration for a Firedancer validator instance. It sets the instance name, operating user, file paths, logging, gossip, snapshot loading, RPC, consensus checks, memory pools, CPU tile layout, network stack, and tile-specific behavior. It also includes development-only options that change sandboxing, network namespaces, benchmarking, and test tools, while production settings control how the validator joins the cluster, processes transactions, and stores chain data. The file is central to deployment because it binds the validator to local system resources and to the Solana network rules it must follow.
